name: settings
description: Represents application or system configuration. On hover the gear performs a single mechanical detent turn: it engages a partial rotation, holds, and releases back to rest.

provenance.attribution: Based on the Ant Design "setting" icon (MIT License). Geometry unchanged; presentation adapted for trix-icons (currentColor, root width/height removed, empty bounding-box rect removed).
provenance.notes: The icon uses a 1024x1024 coordinate space rather than the trix-icons standard 24x24 viewBox; this is a documented intentional deviation to preserve the exact geometry of the source mark. The animation treatment is original implementation work by trix-icons. Base artwork provided directly by the project maintainer.

animation.description: The whole mark rotates 30deg clockwise about its center with ease-in-out (engagement), pauses briefly, then returns to rest (release) - a single detent click of a mechanism being adjusted. Out-and-back is used instead of a snap-back so the animation never assumes geometric symmetry of the source mark. Deliberately partial: refresh owns the full 360deg cycle.

accessibility.notes: Provide context when used inside a button or link.
